title: Leave a way back
task: Help someone close a work session while leaving a useful starting point for tomorrow.
notice: Exploratory ideas, not built prototypes or cultural studies. Human review unrecorded.

synthesis.title: Unfinished Sentence Handoff
synthesis.action: User ends each open thread with a half-sentence, then marks sure, guess, or unknown via keys or drag.
synthesis.feedback: Tomorrow opens on the unknown thread's half-sentence, its stated reason, and a one-tap correct-tag option.
synthesis.mechanism: Certainty sorts restart order; a defined band rubric and undo history keep tags honest and correctable.
synthesis.difference: The restart point is the user's own unfinished thought, ranked by doubt rather than priority.
synthesis.risks: Tag fatigue, overclaimed certainty, unclear band meanings; mitigate with three fixed bands and optional skipping.
synthesis.feasibility: Single offline HTML page, localStorage, fictional threads, keyboard and screen-reader paths, no sensors.
synthesis.prototype: Proposed clickable mockup with three fictional threads; untested; would compare restart speed against a plain checklist.

proposals.title: Confidence Bookmark Handoff
proposals.action: User drags a slider marking how sure each next step feels.
proposals.feedback: Note card renders solid, sketchy, or dotted text matching certainty.
proposals.mechanism: Certainty tagging shapes tomorrow's opening card order and visual weight.
proposals.difference: Uncertainty becomes visible material, not hidden behind confident summaries.
proposals.risks: Users may overthink ratings or feel judged by dotted text.
proposals.feasibility: Local web page, fictional tasks, localStorage only, no sensors.
proposals.prototype: Clickable HTML mockup with three fictional tasks and editable certainty.

proposals.title: Confidence Ledger Handoff
proposals.action: User drags open threads onto a sure-to-unsure confidence slider.
proposals.feedback: Each thread shows certainty band; unsure ones become tomorrow's questions.
proposals.mechanism: Explicit state machine: open, parked, uncertain, resolved; every transition undoable.
proposals.difference: Captures honest uncertainty spatially instead of a flat checklist summary.
proposals.risks: Slider fatigue; users may overstate confidence; ambiguous band meanings.
proposals.feasibility: Single offline HTML page with localStorage and fictional sample threads.
proposals.prototype: Proposed: drag-to-band UI, undo history, morning question card view.

proposals.title: Confidence-Tagged Handoff Note
proposals.action: User drags session fragments into sure, unsure, and unknown lanes.
proposals.feedback: Tomorrow's note shows lanes with editable confidence labels and open questions.
proposals.mechanism: Sorting by certainty, not priority, produces an honest restart point.
proposals.difference: Uncertainty becomes explicit structure instead of hidden in vague notes.
proposals.risks: Users may over-mark everything unsure, diluting the starting point.
proposals.feasibility: Simple offline web page using fictional fragments and local storage.
proposals.prototype: Paper or clickable mockup; observe whether users start from unsure lane.

proposals.title: Confidence Ledger Handoff
proposals.action: User tabs through open threads, tagging each sure, guess, or unknown.
proposals.feedback: Screen reader announces each tag; unknowns surface first tomorrow.
proposals.mechanism: Keyboard-only triage sorts tomorrow's note by stated certainty, not recency.
proposals.difference: Uncertainty becomes navigable structure rather than hidden or decorative labeling.
proposals.risks: Tag fatigue; users may overclaim certainty to finish faster.
proposals.feasibility: Single offline HTML page with localStorage and fictional sample threads.
proposals.prototype: Arrow keys move, S/G/U tag, Z undoes, Enter edits.

synthesis.title: Retie Ledger: Reversible Handoff for Tomorrow
synthesis.action: User places each open task as tied, spliced, or loose, choosing tomorrow's first thread.
synthesis.feedback: Plain labels show stated confidence; morning view surfaces loose ends with the user's own doubt notes.
synthesis.mechanism: Every closing choice is reversible; untying restores prior state with visible, legible repair history.
synthesis.difference: Closure becomes correctable joints with history, not checkboxes, summaries, or forced confidence scores.
synthesis.risks: Metaphor may confuse; comprehension untested; extra closing steps may tire users at day's end.
synthesis.feasibility: Single offline HTML file with fictional tasks, local storage, and stored edit history.
synthesis.prototype: Proposed: compare metaphor version against plain-list baseline; test retie, correction, and morning repair log.

proposals.title: Loose Threads Ledger
proposals.action: User ties off each open task as knot, splice, or loose end.
proposals.feedback: Each thread shows a confidence fray reflecting stated uncertainty tomorrow.
proposals.mechanism: Binding states are reversible; untying restores prior note with visible history.
proposals.difference: Closure becomes repairable joints, not checkboxes or summaries.
proposals.risks: Metaphor may confuse; fraying could feel like judgment.
proposals.feasibility: Local web page with fictional tasks and stored edit history.
proposals.prototype: Single HTML file; drag threads, retie, review morning repair log.

proposals.title: Reservoir Handoff
proposals.action: User drains open tasks into tomorrow's reservoir, setting each flow rate.
proposals.feedback: Water level shows committed load; murky water marks uncertain items.
proposals.mechanism: Drag tasks as streams; cloudiness slider records confidence, user-corrected anytime.
proposals.difference: Uncertainty is a visible stock property, not a hidden checkbox.
proposals.risks: Metaphor may confuse; murkiness could feel judgmental or vague.
proposals.feasibility: Single offline web page with fictional tasks and local storage.
proposals.prototype: Clickable HTML mock: drag five fictional tasks, adjust clarity, review.

proposals.title: Exit Blocking: Staging Tomorrow's First Scene
proposals.action: User drags open tasks onto a stage, placing one downstage center.
proposals.feedback: Items fade by confidence; uncertain ones stand in dim wings.
proposals.mechanism: Proximity to center encodes priority; wing placement marks honest uncertainty.
proposals.difference: Spatial blocking replaces lists, making certainty and focus visibly separate.
proposals.risks: Metaphor may confuse; overplacing items could recreate clutter.
proposals.feasibility: Single offline HTML canvas with fictional tasks and local storage.
proposals.prototype: Proposed: drag tokens, tap to correct confidence, replay tomorrow's entrance.

proposals.title: Airlock Handoff Log
proposals.action: User seals session by tagging each open task's confidence level.
proposals.feedback: Tasks glow solid, flicker, or dim by stated certainty.
proposals.mechanism: Habitat-style airlock cycle forces triage before session can close.
proposals.difference: Uncertainty is recorded explicitly rather than hidden behind neat summaries.
proposals.risks: Extra closing friction may annoy tired users at day's end.
proposals.feasibility: Simple offline web app using local storage and fictional tasks.
proposals.prototype: Clickable HTML mock with editable tags and next-morning view.
